text:
We piloted an AI note-taker with a 12-person field sales team for one quarter. Here's what we learned.

**1. Reps got time back.** Post-call admin dropped from roughly 25 minutes to under 10. That meant more selling time, not just tidier CRM records.

**2. Notes improved, not just sped up.** Next steps and objections were captured consistently, so managers finally saw patterns across deals.

**3. Consent matters.** Our biggest early friction was customers unsure about recording. A simple, upfront opt-in script fixed it.

**4. Adoption followed trust.** Usage jumped once we promised summaries wouldn't be used for rep scorecards.

**5. Humans still own the follow-up.** AI drafts; reps personalize.

The tool worked because we treated it as a coaching aid, not surveillance.
